title: Akiyama Mizuki — Unyielding Obsession〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Diner

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hey, everyone, thanks for waiting♪

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
You're late, Mizuki!
We were just about to start watching without you.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Hey, don't be so impatient, Ena.
I'm only late by about five minutes.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Since we're all here now, shall we begin?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Okay.
I'll start the video now.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: We received so many comments this time too!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: The chorus seems to be the most popular part.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: That's the part Mizuki sang.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hmph! I asked this friend of mine who's a great singer to share some tips with me♪

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Also, the lyrics here were fantastic, so I had a lot of fun singing them.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes, I agree that the lyrics for that part were very good.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
You do?
I'm glad you liked them.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: But you have to give me some credit for expressing Mafuyu's lyrics so well too♪ Right, Ena?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Ena?
Is she still watching the video?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
She looks so serious.
We had better not talk to her now.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Is Ena looking for comments about the illustrations?)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Many people commented about the lyrics and melody for this song, but not about the illustrations...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I think Ena's illustrations for this song were really good.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes, I agree.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I think so too.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: The thumbnail captures the mood of the song perfectly and makes it obvious this is a song by us!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Is that some sort of misguided attempt to cheer me up? I don't need any of that.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: No! I meant it!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Really... Okay, fine.
Anyway, I'm starting to get hungry.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Me too.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: How about fries? Let's order some fries!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Again?! You eat that every time.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Because I like them.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Don't complain if you start getting acne everywhere!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Don't worry!
Acne can't help but stay away from someone as cute as I am♪

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Okay, fine. Good for you.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Though we're chatting together happily like this now, we're all still weighed down by our own burdens.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I would like to have some fries too.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (For Kanade, it's her father.)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Then let's order that.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Mafuyu can't find her true self.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Okay, I'll get a drink too since they offer free refills.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Ena's always struggling with her drawings too.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (And then there's myself...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (But it's tough to always be in agony, so...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Excuse me, waiter!
Three large portions of fries for this table, please♪

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: How much are you intending to eat?!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: As much as I can because it's my favorite food♪

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (I'm allowed to enjoy my life at least for now, right?)
